query: Change the output audio format from MP3 to FLAC.

desired.outcome: Workflow saves output as a FLAC file instead of MP3: the rendered AUDIO wire is retargeted from SaveAudioMP3 to the indexed SaveAudio saver (display name 'Save Audio (FLAC)'), which accepts the identical required AUDIO input.
desired.quality: The new saver node is correctly wired to the same AUDIO stream and all other nodes stay connected; audio is written in FLAC format.

_tags.author_rationale: Straightforward format change that tests parameter-level editing on a simple TTS workflow. MP3-to-WAV was disproved - no WAV saver exists anywhere in the authoritative object_info index - so the query aligns to MP3-to-FLAC: exact index lookups resolve SaveAudio as 'Save Audio (FLAC)' taking the same required AUDIO input as SaveAudioMP3, making the swap authorable on the existing graph.
